title: Mixing: Looking Over From My Hotel Window, Catman (The Rosies Are Coming) by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Two songs on Yoko Ono‘s third album Approximately Infinite Universe were mixed on 28 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

‘Looking Over From My Hotel Window’ had been recorded on 25 November. The first mixes were created on 27 November, but were replaced on this day.

‘Catman (The Rosies Are Coming)’ was recorded on 23 and 24 October. It was first mixed on 5 November, but the results were not used. Neither were this day’s, as the final mix was created the following day.
